facts.name: Catalog heading and unit total
facts.detail: The 2026-2027 University Catalog program heading is Computer Science, M.S.: 30 units.

facts.name: Major required units
facts.detail: The catalog lists 13 units of major required courses. Earlier department-page facts used a required list without CS 5215 and a different elective-unit split; both sources are kept and no winner is chosen.

facts.name: Major elective unit range
facts.detail: The catalog sets major electives at 12-15 units.

facts.name: Elective units with project vs thesis
facts.detail: Students select 15 semester units of electives with the Master's Degree Project or 12 semester units with the Master's Degree Thesis. Earlier department-page fact f26 quoted 18 units with the project or 15 with the thesis; both quotes are kept and no winner is chosen.
facts.quote: Select 15 semester units (with Master's Degree Project) or 12 semester units (with Master's Degree Thesis)

facts.name: Culminating experience unit range and options
facts.detail: Students choose Option 1 (2 units) or Option 2 (5 units) for the culminating experience.
facts.quote: Culminating Experience: 2-5 units Choose Option 1 (2 units) or Option 2 (5 units).

facts.name: Project vs thesis recommendation
facts.detail: The page recommends the MS Project for students seeking industry placement right after graduation, and the MS Thesis for research labs or advanced education such as a Ph.D.
facts.quote: In general, MS Project is recommended for students seeking industry placement right after graduation. MS Thesis option is recommended for students seeking placement at research labs and/or advanced education such as PhD.

facts.name: Option 1 project units
facts.detail: Option 1 requires 1 unit of CS 6910 Directed Research and 1 unit of CS 6950 Master's Degree Project. The catalog titles CS 6910 Directed Research; an earlier department-page fact called it Directed Study. Both quotes are kept and no winner is chosen.
facts.quote: Option 1: 2 units CS 6910 - Directed Research (1-3) (1 unit required) CS 6950 - Master's Degree Project (1) (1 unit required)

facts.name: Option 2 thesis units
facts.detail: Option 2 requires 2 units of CS 6910 Directed Research and 3 units of CS 6960 Master's Degree Thesis.
facts.quote: Option 2: 5 units CS 6910 - Directed Research (1-3) (2 units required) CS 6960 - Master's Degree Thesis (1-3) (3 units required)

facts.name: 4000-level elective cap and excluded courses
facts.detail: Up to 6 semester units of CS 4000+ electives may count, excluding CS 4000, 4310, 4610, 4620, 4630, and 4800.
facts.quote: Computer Science MS students can take up to 6 semester units of CS 4000+ level elective classes to satisfy their elective courses requirement, excluding the following courses: CS 4000 , CS 4310 , CS 4610 , CS 4620 , CS 4630 , and CS 4800 .

facts.name: No repeat of undergraduate 4000-level classes
facts.detail: Those 4000+ classes cannot be ones the student already took as an undergraduate.
facts.quote: However, these 4000+ level classes cannot be classes that a CS MS student already took in their undergraduate curriculum.

facts.name: CS 4990 and CS 5990 unit caps
facts.detail: A master's contract may include at most 6 semester units of CS 4990 and 6 semester units of CS 5990.
facts.quote: Therefore, in a master's contract, a CS MS student can have a maximum of 6 semester units of CS 4990 and 6 semester units of CS 5990 course credits.
